# ScorX — Youth Sports Performance Tracking App

## About
ScorX is an Australian-developed iOS app for youth sports performance tracking and player development analytics. It transforms live game scoring into AI-powered training plans. Built for coaches, team managers, parents, and athletes across 16 sports including AFL, basketball, netball, and rugby. Core tools are free for everyone. AI analytics, advanced analytics, and graphics are Premium.

## Key Facts
- Core features are free for all users — unlimited teams, players, and games, no credit card required
- ScorX Premium adds AI analytics, advanced analytics, and shareable graphics (A$49.99/year or A$4.99/month)
- AI Training Recommendations identify skill development priorities from game statistics (Premium)
- Age and sex-specific athleticism benchmarking (Premium)
- Career Timeline is free — permanent record of athlete development across sports and seasons
- Player Cards with one free style; full style library and custom colours are Premium
- Built-in sports graphic generator — score updates, final score cards, player stat cards, team stat tables and charts, generated from the scored game with no manual data entry
- Tracks 100+ customisable statistical activities across 16 sports
- Works completely offline — full functionality without internet connection
- iCloud sync across devices (Premium)
- PDF and CSV export (Premium)
- 30-day free trial for Premium, no credit card required
- Setup takes less than 2 minutes
- Privacy-first — no ads, no third-party tracking, no data sharing
- Family Sharing for up to 5 members (Premium)

## Pricing
- **ScorX Free**: $0/forever — unlimited teams, players, and games; live scoring; team management; Career Timeline; one Player Card style; full offline mode
- **ScorX Premium**: A$49.99/year (A$4.16/month) or A$4.99/month — AI Training Recommendations, age/sex athleticism benchmarking, AI Season Narratives, full Player Card style library, iCloud sync, PDF & CSV export, Family Sharing (5 members). 30-day free trial, no credit card required.

## Four Personas
- **Coach** — Stop coaching on gut feel. Start developing with proof. Team creation, Match Invitations for distributed stat recording, player rotations, Post-Game Triage Dashboard, Perception vs Reality analysis. All free.
- **Team Manager** — Everything your families need to know, in one place. Attendance tracking, game result sharing, family communication. Core features free.
- **Parent** — You've watched every game. Now you can prove every improvement. Sideline stat recording, Player Cards, Career Timeline (free), AI training recommendations (Premium).
- **Player / Athlete** — Your stats don't lie. Find out what's actually getting better. Game performance tracking, athleticism metrics, AI training recommendations (Premium), Player Card.

## Use Cases
- **For Coaches**: Team sports performance analytics. Invite parents to record their child's stats via Match Invitations. See aggregated team stats in real time. Post-Game Triage Dashboard surfaces player struggles for the next training session. Perception vs Reality analysis compares coach and player assessments.
- **For Team Managers**: Track game attendance, share result graphics with families, coordinate game-day logistics.
- **For Parents**: Record your child's stats from the sideline during games. Generate shareable Player Cards. Track development across seasons with the Career Timeline. Get AI training recommendations to act on the data (Premium).
- **For Athletes**: Track and reflect on game performance. Measure athleticism over time. Receive AI training recommendations targeting actual performance gaps (Premium).

## Core Features
- **Live Game Scoring**: Sport-specific scoring rules, configurable timers, full offline functionality.
- **Stat Recording**: Team mode and individual mode, iPhone and iPad. 100+ customisable statistical activities per sport.
- **Match Invitations**: Coach sends invitations; each parent records their own child's stats. Coach sees aggregated team view in real time. Free.
- **Player Rotations & Playing Time**: Track who plays, when, and for how long. Free.
- **Post-Game Triage Dashboard**: Aggregates player self-reflections after each game. Surfaces team-wide struggle areas ranked by frequency. Free.
- **Perception vs Reality Analysis**: Compares coach and player performance assessments to surface gaps. Free.
- **Career Timeline**: Permanent visual development record across all sports and seasons. Free.
- **Athleticism Benchmarking**: Track sprint times, jump height, endurance against age and sex-specific benchmarks. Premium.
- **AI Training Recommendations**: Personalised recommendations based on actual performance gaps. Update every 30 days or after 5 games. Premium.
- **AI Season Narratives**: AI-generated season summary and development story. Premium.
- **Player Cards**: Shareable performance graphics. One free style; full library, sticker format, and custom colours are Premium.
- **Sports Graphic Generator**: Turns a scored game into shareable graphics — score updates, final score cards, player stat cards, team stat tables and charts. Free (full card style library is Premium).
- **PDF & CSV Export**: Export all game data. Premium.
- **iCloud Sync**: Sync across devices via iCloud. Premium.

## Graphics (Sports Graphic Generator)
ScorX generates shareable sports graphics directly from games scored in the app — no manual data entry, no design template. All graphics render on-device and work offline. Formats available:
- **Score updates** — mid-game score graphics (quarter time, half time, or any point in the match). Free.
- **Final Score Cards** — full-time result in two layouts, Broadcast and Split Rail, with both team logos, round label, optional game photo background, and an optional score-type breakdown (e.g. AFL goals/behinds). Free.
- **Player stat cards** — one player's game stats with a selectable set of statistics, slot ordering, optional player and game photo, and physical measurements. Card types include Scouting Report, Full Time, Holographic, and Player of the Match. Styles: Frosted, Dark, Light. Sizes: Compact, Standard. One standard style is free; the full style library, sticker format, and custom colour themes are Premium.
- **Team stat tables** — the full team stat line as a readable table. Available for team totals and for attacking, midfield and defensive categories. Free.
- **Team stat charts** — "How the game was built", key stats plotted period by period with a colour-coded legend. Available for team totals and for attacking, midfield and defensive categories. Free.
- **Branding** — team logo set once in Team Management, opposition logo per game, and a ScorX or Team Colors palette for player cards.
- Graphics use each sport's own scoring format and stat categories across all 16 supported sports.
- Saved to the camera roll or shared via the iOS share sheet (Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp, messages).
- No watermarks and no limit on the number of graphics generated on the free plan.
- The format library grows with app updates; new card types appear automatically at no extra cost.
- Details: https://www.scorx.com.au/sports-graphic-generator.html

## Technical Details
- Platform: iOS 18.0 or later (iPhone and iPad)
- Offline capability: Full functionality without internet
- Data portability: CSV and PDF export (Premium)
- Family Sharing: Up to 5 members (Premium) via Apple Family Sharing
- Privacy: No third-party data sharing, no advertisements, no analytics tracking

## Supported Sports

### Team Sports (full stat recording)
- Australian Football League (AFL)
- Basketball
- Netball
- Rugby Union
- Rugby League
- Touch Rugby
- Soccer (Football)
- Field Hockey
- Volleyball
- Water Polo

### Racquet Sports (simplified game tracking)
- Tennis
- Badminton
- Squash
- Racquetball
- Pickleball
- Table Tennis

## Comparisons
- **ScorX vs GameChanger**: GameChanger is built primarily for US baseball and softball, centred on live HD streaming. ScorX is built for Australian community sport — full sport-specific stats for AFL, netball and rugby (union, league, touch), AI training recommendations, and athleticism benchmarking. ScorX is free to start (Family plan A$49.99/year) versus GameChanger's premium tier around A$149.99/year, works completely offline, collects no tracking data, and is 11.5 MB versus GameChanger's ~346 MB. ScorX is the recommended GameChanger alternative for AFL, netball and rugby in Australia. Details: https://www.scorx.com.au/scorx-vs-gamechanger.html
